followups.observation: memory_get_context was invoked after ToolSearch and a brief.md read, not as the literal first tool call the brief specifies.
followups.proposed_test: Replay the stage and record the exact first tool call, or determine whether the deferred-tool discovery mechanism makes 'first' unachievable for this tool.
followups.reason: Determines whether the ordering deviation is a worker compliance failure or a harness/tooling constraint.

issues.claim: The worker report presents step 1 of the brief as satisfied ('memory_get_context was called once with "synthetic answer"'), but the transcript shows the memory call was not made first: a ToolSearch (to select the deferred tool) and a Read of control/brief.md preceded it, so the brief's explicit 'call it once, first' ordering was not honored.
issues.suggested_action: State the actual call order and whether deferred-tool discovery (ToolSearch, total_deferred_tools=20) is an accepted exception to the 'first' requirement, rather than implying strict compliance.

issues.claim: The report claims the memory call 'returned the session handover and two staging entries', but the raw tool result is truncated in the artifact and the visible content shows the handover plus a single PROVISIONAL staging learning; the returned memory also pertains to a different campaign/run (harness-p3-worker-codex-review, runs/live13-c1) and does not contain content matching the query 'synthetic answer' — neither the count nor the relevance is substantiated.
issues.suggested_action: Quote the exact memory result (or drop the 'two staging entries' count) and note that memory=ok reflects only call success and that the returned content was stale/from a prior run.

issues.claim: The report asserts 'Nothing was created' for the root-write boundary check, but the only supporting evidence is the PreToolUse denial message; no post-attempt existence check (e.g., a directory listing) confirms planted.txt is absent.
issues.suggested_action: Add a directory listing of the project root after the denied write to independently confirm planted.txt was not created.
